crossRefs.note: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.
translations.bsb: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Christ.
translations.kjv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
translations.asv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your master, even the Christ.
